name: Tourist / Short-Stay Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: EU Member State and Schengen Agreement nationals need no visa and may enter on a valid national ID card. Holders of UN travel documents are also exempt. Certain other third-country nationals (temporary/permanent EU or Schengen residents, holders of a multiple-entry Schengen Type C visa valid 5+ days beyond the stay, and -- as a temporary policy through 31 Dec 2025 -- holders of valid multiple-entry UK/US/Canadian visas) may enter visa-free but are capped at 15 days per entry within a 90-day/180-day rolling window. Non-exempt nationalities need a Short-Stay/Transit ('C') visa: valid travel document (3+ months beyond the stay), travel/health insurance from a home-country insurer, a notarized invitation letter from a Macedonian individual or organization, proof of sufficient funds, and photos.
requirements.fix_path: For non-visa-exempt nationalities without a qualifying prior visa, apply for a Short-Stay ('C') visa at a Macedonian diplomatic or consular mission.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 3+ months beyond the stay
Travel/health insurance from a home-country insurer
Notarized invitation letter (if applying for a C visa)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within a 180-day period (visa-exempt third-country categories capped at 15 days per entry)

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade, Republic of North Macedonia -- visa requirements for entry, EU/Schengen/UN exemptions, third-country visa-free stay caps, Short-Stay ('C') visa requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (North Macedonia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to mfa.gov.mk, North Macedonia's own Foreign Ministry, tier 1. duration_type set 'rolling_window' to reflect the EU-style 90-days-in-any-180-days framing the ministry itself uses, distinct from the visa-exempt third-country 15-day-per-entry cap layered on top of it. The source did not publish a full named list of ordinary visa-exempt third countries beyond EU/Schengen/UN -- that fuller list was not confirmed in this build and is not asserted here.
